```yaml
name: Test Meshery Integration
on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]
    paths-ignore:
      - 'system/**'
      - '*.md'
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  test-meshery-integration:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout Sistent
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          path: sistent

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          cache: 'npm'
          cache-dependency-path: sistent/package-lock.json

      - name: Install Sistent dependencies
        run: |
          cd sistent
          npm ci

      - name: Pack Sistent
        id: pack
        run: |
          cd sistent
          npm pack
          echo "tarball=$(ls *.tgz)" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Checkout Meshery UI
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          repository: meshery/meshery
          path: meshery

      - name: Install Sistent into Meshery UI
        run: |
          cd meshery
          npm install ../sistent/${{ steps.pack.outputs.tarball }}

      - name: Verify test script exists
        id: verify_test_script
        run: |
          cd meshery
          if ! grep -E '"test"\s*:' package.json; then
            echo "No test script found in package.json"
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "test_script_exists=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Install Meshery UI dependencies
        if: always()
        run: |
          cd meshery
          npm ci

      - name: Run Meshery UI tests
        if: steps.verify_test_script.outputs.test_script_exists == 'true'
        run: |
          cd meshery
          npm test

      - name: Report Results
        if: failure()
        run: |
          echo "Integration test failed. Please review the logs above."
```
